description: This is a PHP source file defining the PerformanceTrackerLogDao class, which provides data access methods for PerformanceTrackerLog entities within the OrangeHRM performance module. It includes methods for retrieving, saving, deleting logs, and building complex queries based on filters.

classes.name: PerformanceTrackerLogDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for PerformanceTrackerLog entity providing methods to retrieve, update, and delete performance tracker logs.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogById
methods.description: Retrieves a PerformanceTrackerLog by its ID if its status is not deleted.

methods.name: getExistingPerformanceTrackerLogIdsForTrackerId
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing PerformanceTrackerLogs for a given tracker ID among specified IDs.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsByTrackerId
methods.description: Fetches PerformanceTrackerLogs based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogQueryBuilder
methods.description: Builds a query for retrieving PerformanceTrackerLogs with filtering and sorting.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsRateCount
methods.description: Counts logs with a specific rating for a given tracker.

methods.name: savePerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Persists a PerformanceTrackerLog entity to the database.

methods.name: deletePerformanceTrackerLog
methods.description: Marks logs as deleted based on their IDs.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogIdsByUserId
methods.description: Retrieves log IDs associated with a specific user.

methods.name: getPerformanceTrackerLogsIdList
methods.description: Gets list of all log IDs where the associated employee has not been purged.
